hero.subheading: Three decades behind the chair. Precision fades, straight-razor finishes, and color work for men who don't ask twice for the same result.

about.quote: A good haircut isn't a trend. It's a decision you make about how you carry yourself.
about.paragraph1: Ismel learned the trade in Havana before bringing it to Georgetown — old-world technique, no shortcuts. Every service starts the same way: a conversation about your hair, your face, and what you actually want to look like on a Tuesday, not just for a photo.
about.paragraph2: The shop keeps a short client list on purpose. Fewer chairs, more attention, and a standard that doesn't change whether it's your first visit or your two-hundredth.

testimonial.quote: Whole heap of barbers can throw a fast fade, but Ismel does take his time and hook you up proper. Fresh, clean, line precise every single time. Real talk, you can't beat the man craft.
